pfd-left.title: Left Primary Flight Display (PFD 1)
pfd-left.description: Primary Flight Display provides airspeed, attitude, altitude, vertical speed, flight modes, and course deviation information. In addition to the flight instruments, flight plan, navigation, communication, terrain, traffic, and weather information are also presented on the PFD.

mfd-left.title: Left Multi-Function Display (MFD 1) (STATUS / EICAS)
mfd-left.description:
The EICAS displays engine and system parameters such as flap, gear, spoilers and trim positions, total fuel quantity, APU, and environmental information.
The EICAS also displays crew awareness messages.
STATUS PAGE:
A dedicated page on MFD is available for the crew to achieve status information about:
-Flight
-Battery
-Engine Oil Level
-Brake
-Crew Oxygen
-Doors.

mfd-right.title: Right Multi-Function Display (MFD 2)
mfd-right.description: The Multi Function Display (MFD) contains menu softkeys, on the top and bottom of the screen, used to select formats and control various systems. The upper menu bar has three menu title buttons to select synoptics, map, and plan navigation formats. The synoptic formats selectable by the flight crew are displayed in the upper area of the screen. The lower menu bar has three menu title buttons to select TCAS zoom, weather virtual controller and electronic checklist in the lower area of the screen. If nothing has been selected for display in the lower area, it remains blank.

pfd-right.title: Right Primary Flight Display (PFD 2)
pfd-right.description: Displays First Officer primary flight instruments: attitude, airspeed, barometric altitude, vertical speed, heading/HSI, and AFCS Flight Mode Annunciations (FMA).

isis-screen.title: Integrated eletronic Stanby System (IESS)
isis-screen.description:
NORMAL OPERATION
During normal operation, the IESS computes and displays attitude, slip-skid indication, altitude (baro corrected), airspeed, vertical speed, Mach number and IESS. The buttons functionalities are:
- CAGE pushbutton: if depressed, the standby performs a CAGE in the internal gyros to cancel the accumulated drift. User: vlmorei0f - Printed by TechPubs - Aug 03/26 - 19:22:41
- ILS button: if pressed, glideslope and localizer deviations is displayed.
- STD button: if pressed, STD baro is set. To adjust baro, rotate the knob.
- '+' and '-' buttons: controls display brightness.
- 'Push FT-M' in the Guidance Panel: automatically displays altitude in meters.
- 'MAIN PNL' in the Overhead Panel: controls IESI bezel illumination.
The IESS is powered as soon as the airplane battery 1 is selected to ON and airplane battery 2 is selected to AUTO. Then, the IESS starts its alignment phase. The initial IESS alignment takes about 90 seconds to be completed and can be identified on the screen by the 'INIT 90 s' flag.
NOTE: The airplane must not be moved during the first 90 seconds after power-up, while the IESS is undergoing alignment. Moving the airplane during this period can cause in-flight attitude indication errors that may not be noticeable on ground.

mcdu-left-screen.title: Left Multifunction Control Display Unit (MCDU 1)
mcdu-left-screen.description: The MCDU allows radio tuning, PFD radio display setup, manual TRS, engine takeoff set, avionics display setup and test, performance initialization, flight planning, access to electronics CBs, and others.

mcdu-right-screen.title: Right Multifunction Control Display Unit (MCDU 2)
mcdu-right-screen.description: The MCDU allows radio tuning, PFD radio display setup, manual TRS, engine takeoff set, avionics display setup and test, performance initialization, flight planning, access to electronics CBs, and others.

dvdr-test-btn.title: DVDR Test Button
dvdr-test-btn.description: Simultaneously tests all CVR and FDR functions on both DVDR.

dvdr-erase-btn.title: CVR Erase Button
dvdr-erase-btn.description: Erases the recorded audio information, provided that the airplane is on the ground and Emergency/Parking Brake is applied.

elt-switch.title: ELT Selector Switch (ARM / ON)
elt-switch.description:
Controls the Emergency Locator Transmitter.
ARM: Automatically transmits on impact.
ON: Manually activates emergency transmission.

elec-idg1-knob.title: IDG 1 Selector Knob
elec-idg1-knob.description:
Controls Integrated Drive Generator 1.
AUTO: Automatic operation of the electrical main generation system.
OFF:  opens the IDG contactor isolating the IDG from the respective AC BUS. 
DISC: If held in this position for at least 1 second, mechanically disconnects the IDG.
 IDG FAULT INDICATION LED
The IDG fault indication LED illuminates indicating which IDG must be disconnected in case the EICAS message IDG 1 (2) OIL is displayed. The LED extinguishes after IDG disconnection.

elec-idg2-knob.title: IDG 2 Selector Knob
elec-idg2-knob.description:
Controls Integrated Drive Generator 1.
AUTO: Automatic operation of the electrical main generation system.
OFF:  opens the IDG contactor isolating the IDG from the respective AC BUS. 
DISC: If held in this position for at least 1 second, mechanically disconnects the IDG.
 IDG FAULT INDICATION LED
The IDG fault indication LED illuminates indicating which IDG must be disconnected in case the EICAS message IDG 1 (2) OIL is displayed. The LED extinguishes after IDG disconnection.

elec-apu-gen-btn.title: APU GEN Button
elec-apu-gen-btn.description:
PUSH IN: allows automatic operation of the electrical auxiliary generation system. 
PUSH OUT: opens the APU generator line contactor and isolates the APU generator from the AC BUS TIE

elec-gpu-btn.title: Ground Power Unit (GPU) Button
elec-gpu-btn.description:
PUSH IN: allows the AC GPU to connect in the AC system, according to the source priority.
PUSH OUT: Isolates the AC GPU from the system.
AVAIL: Illuminates inside the button when the AC GPU is connected to the airplane and AC power quality requirements are satisfied.
IN USE: Illuminates inside the button when the AC GPU is powering the airplane AC electrical system.

elec-ac-bus-ties-knob.title: AC BUS TIES Selector Knob
elec-ac-bus-ties-knob.description:
Controls AC Bus Tie Contactors (BTC 1 & 2).
1 OPEN: opens the Bus Tie Contactor (BTC) 1, while (BTC) 2 is automatically operated.
AUTO: allows automatic operation of the electrical system.
2 OPEN: opens the Bus Tie Contactor (BTC) 2, while (BTC) 1 is automatically operated.

elec-tru1-knob.title: TRU 1 Selector Switch
elec-tru1-knob.description:
AUTO: Allows automatic operation of the electrical system.
OFF: Isolates the TRU 1 from the respective DC BUS.

elec-tru-ess-knob.title: TRU ESS Selector Switch
elec-tru-ess-knob.description:
AUTO: Allows automatic operation of the electrical system.
OFF: Isolates the TRU ESS from the DC ESS BUS 3.

elec-tru2-knob.title: TRU 2 SelectorSwitch
elec-tru2-knob.description:
AUTO: Allows automatic operation of the electrical system.
OFF: Isolates the TRU 2 from the respective DC BUS.

elec-batt1-knob.title: BATT 1 Knob
elec-batt1-knob.description:
Battery (24V Ni-Cd)
ON: Allows automatic operation of the electrical system. 
OFF: The battery supplies power to the HOT BATT BUS 1 only and is no longer connected to the airplane electrical system.
Power Up: Each battery voltage must be at least 22v

elec-batt2-knob.title: BATT 2 Knob
elec-batt2-knob.description:
Battery (24V Ni-Cd)
ON: Allows automatic operation of the electrical system. 
AUTO: Allows automatic operation of the electrical system. OFF: The battery supplies power to the HOT BATT BUS 2 only and is no longer connected to the airplane electrical system.
Power Up: Each battery voltage must be at least 22v

elec-dc-bus-ties-knob.title: DC Bus Ties Selector Knob
elec-dc-bus-ties-knob.description:
AUTO: allows automatic operation of the electrical system.
OFF: Precludes the closure of both essential tie contactors (ETCs) and the DC tie contactor (DCTC).

ckpt-ovhd-lt-knob.title: OVHD PNL Controller
ckpt-ovhd-lt-knob.description: Turns on and off and regulates the brightness of the overhead panel lighting.

ckpt-main-lt-knob.title: MAIN PNL Controller
ckpt-main-lt-knob.description: Turns on and off and regulates the lighting brightness of the main panel.

ckpt-ped-lt-knob.title: PEDESTAL Controller
ckpt-ped-lt-knob.description: Turns on and off and regulates the lighting brightness of the pedestal panel.

ckpt-annun-test-btn.title: ANNUNCIATOR TEST Button
ckpt-annun-test-btn.description:
PUSH: when maintained pushed in all the striped bars and caption indications turn on to verify their integrity.
NOTE: The Cockpit Lights ANNUNCIATORS TEST Button does not check the GPU button light, the EMER/PRKG BRAKE light and the Fire Extinguisher Cargo Smoke FWD and AFT buttons lights.

ckpt-dome-sw.title: DOME Switch
ckpt-dome-sw.description: Turns the cockpit dome lights on and off.

fire-eng1-handle.title: Engine 1 Fire Extinguisher Handle
fire-eng1-handle.description: Pulling the handle closes Engine 1 fuel, hydraulic, and bleed air shutoff valves, trips IDG 1, and arms the fire extinguishing bottles. Rotating LEFT (A) or RIGHT (B) discharges the respective Halon bottle.

fire-cargo-fwd-btn.title: FWD CARGO Fire / Smoke Extinguisher Button
fire-cargo-fwd-btn.description: Illuminates when smoke is detected in the forward cargo compartment. Pressing arms and discharges the high-rate/low-rate cargo fire extinguishing bottles.

fire-cargo-aft-btn.title: AFT CARGO Fire / Smoke Extinguisher Button
fire-cargo-aft-btn.description: Illuminates when smoke is detected in the aft cargo compartment. Pressing arms and discharges the cargo fire extinguishing agent.

fire-apu-extg-btn.title: APU Fire Extinguisher (EXTG) Pushbutton
fire-apu-extg-btn.description: Discharges the APU fire extinguisher bottle into the APU compartment when armed by the APU Fire Emergency Stop button.

fire-apu-emer-btn.title: APU Fire Emergency Stop Guarded Button
fire-apu-emer-btn.description: Illuminates red during an APU fire condition. Pressing shuts down the APU, closes the APU fuel shutoff valve, trips the APU generator, and arms the APU extinguisher bottle.

fire-eng2-handle.title: Engine 2 Fire Extinguisher Handle
fire-eng2-handle.description: Pulling the handle isolates Engine 2 fuel, hydraulics, bleed air, and electrical generation, and arms the fire extinguishing bottles. Rotating LEFT (A) or RIGHT (B) discharges the bottle.

fuel-xfeed-knob.title: Fuel Crossfeed (XFEED) Knob (LOW 1 / OFF / LOW 2)
fuel-xfeed-knob.description: Controls fuel balance between left and right wing tanks. LOW 1: Opens crossfeed valve and turns off Tank 1 pump so Tank 2 feeds both engines. LOW 2: Tank 1 feeds both engines.

fuel-ac-pump1-btn.title: AC Fuel Pump 1 Selector Knob (OFF / AUTO / ON)
fuel-ac-pump1-btn.description: Controls Left Wing Tank main AC-powered boost fuel pump.

fuel-ac-pump2-btn.title: AC Fuel Pump 2 Selector Knob (OFF / AUTO / ON)
fuel-ac-pump2-btn.description: Controls Right Wing Tank main AC-powered boost fuel pump.

fuel-dc-pump-btn.title: DC Fuel Pump Selector Knob (OFF / AUTO / ON)
fuel-dc-pump-btn.description: Controls the DC-powered fuel pump located in the right wing collector tank for APU starting and backup engine fuel feed when AC power is unavailable.

pax-emer-lt-knob.title: EMER LT (Emergency Lights) Knob (OFF / ARM / ON)
pax-emer-lt-knob.description: Controls cabin and exterior emergency escape path lighting. ARM: Automatically illuminates emergency lights if aircraft DC/AC power fails.

pax-sterile-btn.title: ATTND CALL (Flight Attendant Call) Pushbutton
pax-sterile-btn.description: Calls the cabin flight attendant station and illuminates when the cabin crew calls the cockpit.

pax-no-smk-sw.title: STERILE Cockpit Light Switch (OFF / ON)
pax-no-smk-sw.description: Illuminates the sterile cockpit indicator light in the cabin to notify flight attendants that the flight crew is in a critical phase of flight (below 10,000 ft).

pax-fstn-belts-sw.title: NO SMKG / BELTS Sign Switch (OFF / ON)
pax-fstn-belts-sw.description: Controls the cabin No Smoking and Fasten Seat Belts signs and associated cabin chime.

pax-cabin-lt-sw.title: FASTEN BELTS Sign Switch (OFF / ON)
pax-cabin-lt-sw.description: Illuminates cabin Fasten Seat Belts signs and sounds the cabin chime.

apu-fuel-shutoff-btn.title: APU Fuel Shutoff Guarded Pushbutton
apu-fuel-shutoff-btn.description: Closes the APU fuel shutoff valve to isolate fuel supply to the Auxiliary Power Unit.

apu-emer-stop-btn.title: APU Emergency Stop Pushbutton
apu-emer-stop-btn.description: Immediately shuts down the APU without the normal cooldown cycle and closes the APU fuel shutoff valve.

apu-master.title: APU Master Selector Knob (OFF / ON / START)
apu-master.description: Controls the Auxiliary Power Unit. OFF: Initiates normal cooldown and shutdown. ON: Powers APU FADEC and opens fuel valve. START: Momentary position that initiates the automatic APU start sequence.

wiper-left-knob.title: Windshield Wiper 1 (Captain) Knob (OFF / TIMER / LOW / HI)
wiper-left-knob.description: Controls the Captain windshield wiper speed: OFF, TIMER (intermittent), LOW, or HIGH.

wiper-right-knob.title: Windshield Wiper 2 (First Officer) Knob (OFF / TIMER / LOW / HI)
wiper-right-knob.description: Controls the First Officer windshield wiper speed: OFF, TIMER (intermittent), LOW, or HIGH.

ext-nav-sw.title: NAV Lights Switch (OFF / ON)
ext-nav-sw.description: Turns the red/green wingtip and white tail position/navigation lights ON or OFF.

ext-strobe-sw.title: STROBE Lights Switch (OFF / ON)
ext-strobe-sw.description: Turns the high-intensity white wingtip and tail anti-collision strobe lights ON or OFF.

ext-bcn-sw.title: RED BCN (Anti-Collision Beacon) Switch
ext-bcn-sw.description: Turns upper and lower fuselage red anti-collision beacon lights ON or OFF (turned ON prior to engine start).

ext-logo-sw.title: LOGO Lights Switch (OFF / ON)
ext-logo-sw.description: Illuminates the vertical stabilizer emblem for night operations.

ext-taxi-nose-sw.title: TAXI NOSE Light Switch (OFF / ON)
ext-taxi-nose-sw.description: Turns the nose-gear-mounted taxi light ON or OFF (automatically extinguishes when nose gear retracts).

ext-taxi-side-sw.title: TAXI SIDE (Runway Turnoff) Lights Switch
ext-taxi-side-sw.description: Turns the wide-beam side taxi / runway turnoff lights ON or OFF.

ext-insp-sw.title: INSP (Wing Inspection) Lights Switch
ext-insp-sw.description: Illuminates the wing leading edges to visually check for ice accumulation at night.

ext-ldg-left-sw.title: Left LANDING Light Switch (OFF / ON)
ext-ldg-left-sw.description: Controls the left wing root high-intensity landing light.

ext-ldg-nose-sw.title: Nose LANDING Light Switch (OFF / ON)
ext-ldg-nose-sw.description: Controls the nose-gear high-intensity landing light.

ext-ldg-right-sw.title: Right LANDING Light Switch (OFF / ON)
ext-ldg-right-sw.description: Controls the right wing root high-intensity landing light.

hyd-sys1-shutoff-btn.title: Hydraulic System 1 Engine Pump Shutoff Button
hyd-sys1-shutoff-btn.description: Guarded pushbutton that closes the Hydraulic System 1 engine-driven pump (EDP 1) supply shutoff valve.

hyd-ptu-knob.title: PTU (Power Transfer Unit) Selector Knob (OFF / AUTO / ON)
hyd-ptu-knob.description: Controls the mechanical Power Transfer Unit between Hydraulic Systems 1 and 2 to assist landing gear retraction/extension if an engine fails.

hyd-sys2-shutoff-btn.title: Hydraulic System 2 Engine Pump Shutoff Button
hyd-sys2-shutoff-btn.description: Guarded pushbutton that closes the Hydraulic System 2 engine-driven pump (EDP 2) supply shutoff valve.

hyd-sys1-elec-pump-knob.title: Hydraulic System 1 Electric Pump Knob (OFF / AUTO / ON)
hyd-sys1-elec-pump-knob.description: Controls AC Motor Pump 1 (ACMP 1) providing backup and ground hydraulic pressure for System 1.

hyd-sys2-elec-pump-knob.title: Hydraulic System 2 Electric Pump Knob (OFF / AUTO / ON)
hyd-sys2-elec-pump-knob.description: Controls AC Motor Pump 2 (ACMP 2) providing backup and ground hydraulic pressure for System 2.

hyd-sys3a-elec-pump-knob.title: Hydraulic System 3 Electric Pump A Knob (OFF / ON)
hyd-sys3a-elec-pump-knob.description: Controls primary AC Motor Pump 3A (ACMP 3A) pressurizing Hydraulic System 3 for flight controls.

hyd-sys3b-elec-pump-knob.title: Hydraulic System 3 Electric Pump B Knob (OFF / AUTO / ON)
hyd-sys3b-elec-pump-knob.description: Controls backup AC Motor Pump 3B (ACMP 3B) for Hydraulic System 3.

press-cabin-alt-knob.title: CABIN ALT Manual Control Switch (DN / UP)
press-cabin-alt-knob.description: Spring-loaded rotary switch used in MAN mode to manually open (UP) or close (DN) the cabin outflow valve.

press-mode-knob.title: Pressurization MODE Selector Knob (AUTO / LFE CTRL / MAN)
press-mode-knob.description: Selects automatic FMS/CPCS cabin pressurization control (AUTO), manual landing field elevation entry (LFE CTRL), or direct manual outflow valve control (MAN).

press-dump-btn.title: Cabin DUMP Guarded Pushbutton
press-dump-btn.description: Emergency guarded button that turns off both air conditioning packs and commands the outflow valve fully open for rapid cabin depressurization / smoke removal.

press-lfe-knob.title: LFE (Landing Field Elevation) Selector Knob (DN / UP)
press-lfe-knob.description: Adjusts the target Landing Field Elevation on EICAS when the Pressurization Mode knob is set to LFE CTRL.

ice-wshld1-btn.title: WINDSHIELD 1 Heating Pushbutton
ice-wshld1-btn.description: Activates electrical anti-ice and anti-fog heating for the Captain windshield.

ice-wshld2-btn.title: WINDSHIELD 2 Heating Pushbutton
ice-wshld2-btn.description: Activates electrical anti-ice and anti-fog heating for the First Officer windshield.

ice-wing-btn.title: WING Anti-Ice Pushbutton
ice-wing-btn.description: Commands the wing anti-ice valves open to supply hot bleed air to the wing leading-edge slats.

ice-mode-knob.title: ICE PROTECTION MODE Knob (OFF / AUTO / ON)
ice-mode-knob.description: Selects automatic ice detector control (AUTO) or continuous manual activation (ON) of the engine and wing anti-ice systems.

ice-test-knob.title: Ice Detection TEST Selector Knob (ENG / OFF / WING)
ice-test-knob.description: Performs a built-in functional test of the engine and wing ice protection systems.

pneu-ckpt-temp-knob.title: CKPT (Cockpit Temperature) Selector Knob
pneu-ckpt-temp-knob.description: Adjusts the target temperature for the cockpit zone (18°C to 30°C).

pneu-recirc-btn.title: RECIRC (Cabin Recirculation Fan) Pushbutton
pneu-recirc-btn.description: Controls the cabin air recirculation fans to reduce bleed air demand.

pneu-pax-temp-knob.title: PAX (Cabin Temperature) Selector Knob
pneu-pax-temp-knob.description: Adjusts the target temperature for the passenger cabin zone.

pneu-pack1-btn.title: PACK 1 Pushbutton
pneu-pack1-btn.description: Opens or closes Air Conditioning Pack 1 flow control valve.

pneu-pack2-btn.title: PACK 2 Pushbutton
pneu-pack2-btn.description: Opens or closes Air Conditioning Pack 2 flow control valve.

pneu-xbleed-btn.title: XBLEED (Crossbleed Valve) Pushbutton
pneu-xbleed-btn.description: Controls the pneumatic crossbleed valve connecting the left and right pneumatic manifolds for engine starting, anti-ice, or single-bleed pack operation.

pneu-bleed1-btn.title: BLEED 1 (Engine 1 Bleed) Pushbutton
pneu-bleed1-btn.description: Opens or closes Engine 1 bleed air pressure regulating and shutoff valve.

pneu-apu-bleed-btn.title: APU BLEED Pushbutton
pneu-apu-bleed-btn.description: Opens or closes the APU bleed air valve to supply pneumatic air for air conditioning packs and engine starting.

pneu-bleed2-btn.title: BLEED 2 (Engine 2 Bleed) Pushbutton
pneu-bleed2-btn.description: Opens or closes Engine 2 bleed air pressure regulating and shutoff valve.

oxy-mask-knob.title: MASKS Deployment Selector Knob (AUTO / OVRD)
oxy-mask-knob.description: AUTO: Deploys cabin oxygen masks automatically if cabin altitude exceeds ~14,000 ft. OVRD: Manually deploys cabin oxygen masks.

oxy-supply-btn.title: Passenger Oxygen SUPPLY Pushbutton
oxy-supply-btn.description: Controls oxygen flow to the deployed passenger cabin masks.

master-warn-left.title: Left Master Warning (WARN) Pushbutton
master-warn-left.description: Flashes red and sounds a triple chime when a Level 3 Warning CAS message occurs. Pressing extinguishes the flash and silences the aural warning.

master-caut-left.title: Left Master Caution (CAUT) Pushbutton
master-caut-left.description: Illuminates amber and sounds a single chime when a Level 2 Caution CAS message occurs. Pressing resets the caution light.

master-caut-right.title: Right Master Caution (CAUT) Pushbutton
master-caut-right.description: First Officer amber Master Caution reset pushbutton.

master-warn-right.title: Right Master Warning (WARN) Pushbutton
master-warn-right.description: First Officer red Master Warning reset pushbutton.

dcu1-baro-knob.title: Left Barometric Altimeter Knob (BARO / STD)
dcu1-baro-knob.description: Sets the Captain barometric pressure reference (inHg or hPa). Pushing the center button toggles STD (29.92 inHg / 1013 hPa).

dcu1-hsi-btn.title: Left HSI Format Pushbutton (HSI)
dcu1-hsi-btn.description: Toggles the Captain Primary Flight Display (PFD 1) Horizontal Situation Indicator (HSI) format between 360° Compass Rose and Expanded Arc views.

dcu1-wx-btn.title: Left Weather Radar Overlay Pushbutton (WX)
dcu1-wx-btn.description: Toggles the Weather Radar (WX) precipitation returns overlay on the Captain HSI (Arc mode).

dcu1-fms-btn.title: Left FMS Navigation Source Pushbutton (FMS)
dcu1-fms-btn.description: Selects the Flight Management System (FMS) as the primary navigation source displayed on PFD 1.

dcu1-brg1-btn.title: Left Circle Bearing Pointer Pushbutton (BRG O)
dcu1-brg1-btn.description: Cycles the Circle (O) Bearing Pointer on PFD 1 through available navigation sources (VOR 1, ADF 1, FMS 1, or OFF).

dcu1-prev-btn.title: Left Navigation Preview Pushbutton (PREV)
dcu1-prev-btn.description: Displays or hides the cyan Navigation Preview (PREV) course pointer and deviation indicator on PFD 1 for Vor/LOC transition from FMS.

dcu1-nav-btn.title: Left Short-Range Navigation Source Pushbutton (NAV)
dcu1-nav-btn.description: Selects short-range radio navigation (VOR/LOC 1 or VOR/LOC 2) as the active navigation source on PFD 1. Pressing repeatedly toggles between on-side and cross-side sensors.

dcu1-brg2-btn.title: Left Diamond Bearing Pointer Pushbutton (BRG ◇)
dcu1-brg2-btn.description: Cycles the Diamond (◇) Bearing Pointer on PFD 1 through available navigation sources (VOR 2, ADF 2, FMS 2, or OFF).

dcu1-fpr-btn.title: Left Flight Path Reference Pushbutton (FPR)
dcu1-fpr-btn.description: Toggles the Flight Path Reference (FPR) line and Flight Path Vector (FPV) symbol on the Captain Primary Flight Display (PFD 1).

dcu1-mins-knob.title: Left Minimums Selector Knob (RA / BARO)
dcu1-mins-knob.description: Selects Radio Altimeter (RA) or Barometric (BARO) decision height/altitude bug on PFD 1.

fgp-fd1-btn.title: Left Flight Director (FD 1) Button
fgp-fd1-btn.description: Toggles the Captain Flight Director command bars on PFD 1.

fgp-crs1-knob.title: Left Course (CRS 1) Selector Knob
fgp-crs1-knob.description: Sets the selected VOR/LOC course pointer for the Captain HSI. Pushing centers the course deviation needle.

fgp-at-btn.title: Autothrottle (A/T) Engage Button
fgp-at-btn.description: Arms or engages the Automatic Throttle system.

fgp-spd-knob.title: Airspeed / Mach Selector Knob (FMS / MAN)
fgp-spd-knob.description: Outer ring selects FMS-computed speed or Manual speed control. Inner knob sets target IAS/Mach; pushing toggles IAS/Mach mode.

fgp-nav-btn.title: LNAV / Lateral Navigation (NAV) Button
fgp-nav-btn.description: Arms or engages lateral navigation mode (FMS LNAV or VOR/LOC capture).

fgp-hdg-knob.title: Heading (HDG) Selector & Sync Knob
fgp-hdg-knob.description: Rotates to set the selected heading bug on the PFD/MFD. Pushing syncs the heading bug to the current aircraft heading.

fgp-appr-btn.title: Approach (APPR) Mode Button
fgp-appr-btn.description: Arms lateral and vertical approach guidance (ILS LOC/GS or RNAV RNP/LPV approach).

fgp-bank-btn.title: Half Bank Limit (BANK) Button
fgp-bank-btn.description: Limits Flight Director / Autopilot roll bank angle to 17° in HDG mode.

fgp-ap-btn.title: Autopilot (AP) Engage Pushbutton
fgp-ap-btn.description: Engages or disengages the Automatic Flight Control System Autopilot.

fgp-src-btn.title: Navigation Source (SRC) Button
fgp-src-btn.description: Switches the active Flight Director / Autopilot master navigation side between Captain (Left) and First Officer (Right). Side white arrows indicate the active master side.

fgp-appr2-btn.title: Approach (APPR) Mode Button
fgp-appr2-btn.description: Arms or engages lateral and vertical approach guidance (ILS LOC/GS or RNAV RNP/LPV approach).

fgp-alt-knob.title: Altitude Selector Knob (ALT SEL / PUSH FT-M)
fgp-alt-knob.description: Sets the preselected altitude bug on the PFD (outer ring sets 1000 ft increments, inner knob sets 100 ft). Pushing toggles display units between feet and meters.

fgp-alt-btn.title: Altitude Hold (ALT) Mode Button
fgp-alt-btn.description: Engages Altitude Hold (ALT) mode, leveling the aircraft off and maintaining the current barometric altitude.

fgp-vs-wheel.title: Pitch Wheel (DN / UP)
fgp-vs-wheel.description: Thumbwheel that adjusts the vertical speed (VS) target rate of climb/descent or the flight path angle (FPA) reference.

fgp-vs-btn.title: Vertical Speed (VS) Mode Button
fgp-vs-btn.description: Engages or disengages Vertical Speed (VS) vertical flight director/autopilot mode.

fgp-fpa-btn.title: Flight Path Angle (FPA) Mode Button
fgp-fpa-btn.description: Engages or disengages Flight Path Angle (FPA) vertical flight director/autopilot mode.

fgp-fd2-btn.title: Right Flight Director (FD 2) Button
fgp-fd2-btn.description: Toggles the First Officer Flight Director command bars on PFD 2.

fgp-crs2-knob.title: Right Course (CRS 2) Selector Knob (PUSH DIR)
fgp-crs2-knob.description: Sets the selected VOR/LOC course pointer for the First Officer HSI. Pushing the knob (PUSH DIR) centers the course deviation needle directly to the station.

dcu2-mins-knob.title: Right Minimums Selector Knob (RA / BARO)
dcu2-mins-knob.description: Selects Radio Altimeter (RA) or Barometric (BARO) minimums bug on PFD 2.

dcu2-hsi-btn.title: Right HSI Format Pushbutton (HSI)
dcu2-hsi-btn.description: Toggles the First Officer Primary Flight Display (PFD 2) Horizontal Situation Indicator (HSI) format between 360° Compass Rose and Expanded Arc views.

dcu2-wx-btn.title: Right Weather Radar Overlay Pushbutton (WX)
dcu2-wx-btn.description: Toggles the Weather Radar (WX) precipitation returns overlay on the First Officer HSI (Arc mode).

dcu2-fms-btn.title: Right FMS Navigation Source Pushbutton (FMS)
dcu2-fms-btn.description: Selects the Flight Management System (FMS) as the primary navigation source displayed on PFD 2.

dcu2-brg1-btn.title: Right Circle Bearing Pointer Pushbutton (BRG O)
dcu2-brg1-btn.description: Cycles the Circle (O) Bearing Pointer on PFD 2 through available navigation sources (VOR 1, ADF 1, FMS 1, or OFF).

dcu2-prev-btn.title: Right Navigation Preview Pushbutton (PREV)
dcu2-prev-btn.description: Displays or hides the cyan Navigation Preview (PREV) course pointer and deviation indicator on PFD 2 for VOR/LOC transition from FMS.

dcu2-nav-btn.title: Right Short-Range Navigation Source Pushbutton (NAV)
dcu2-nav-btn.description: Selects short-range radio navigation (VOR/LOC 2 or VOR/LOC 1) as the active navigation source on PFD 2. Pressing repeatedly toggles between on-side and cross-side sensors.

dcu2-brg2-btn.title: Right Diamond Bearing Pointer Pushbutton (BRG ◇)
dcu2-brg2-btn.description: Cycles the Diamond (◇) Bearing Pointer on PFD 2 through available navigation sources (VOR 2, ADF 2, FMS 2, or OFF).

dcu2-fpr-btn.title: Right Flight Path Reference Pushbutton (FPR)
dcu2-fpr-btn.description: Toggles the Flight Path Reference (FPR) line and Flight Path Vector (FPV) symbol on the First Officer Primary Flight Display (PFD 2).

dcu2-baro-knob.title: Right Barometric Altimeter Knob (BARO / STD)
dcu2-baro-knob.description: Sets the First Officer barometric pressure reference (inHg or hPa) or toggles STD.

clock-left-btn.title: Captain GPWS / GSPD INHB (Ground Proximity / Glideslope Inhibit) Button
clock-left-btn.description: Allows the Captain to manually inhibit below-glideslope (G/S) alerts or acknowledge/test Ground Proximity Warning System (GPWS) alerts.

reversionary-left-knobs.title: Captain Reversionary & Display Brightness Panel (PFD / MFD / ADS / IRS)
reversionary-left-knobs.description: Contains DISPLAY CONTROLLER (PFD / AUTO / MFD) reversion knob, DISPLAY BRIGHTNESS knobs (PFD 1 & MFD 1), and ADS / IRS sensor reversion pushbuttons.

autobrake-panel.title: AUTOBRAKE Selector Knob (RTO / OFF / LO / MED / HI)
autobrake-panel.description: Selects automatic wheel braking deceleration level for landing (LO, MED, HI) or Rejected Takeoff (RTO) maximum braking.

ldg-gear-lever.title: Landing Gear Control Lever (UP / OFF / DN)
ldg-gear-lever.description: Three-position landing gear selector lever (UP, OFF, DN) with electronic proximity sensing.

eicas-full-panel.title: EMER/PARKING BRAKE
eicas-full-panel.description: Illuminates and parking brake is on

gear-ovrd-btn.title: DN LCK REL (Downlock Release) Button & NOSEWHEEL STEERING Switch
gear-ovrd-btn.description: Top guarded button (DN LCK REL) mechanically overrides the landing gear lever downlock actuator. Bottom guarded switch controls Nosewheel Steering engagement.

clock-right-btn.title: ADS HEATER BUTTON
clock-right-btn.description:
PUSH IN: Activates the ADS probes heater. A striped bar illuminates in the button.
PUSH OUT: The ADS probes heater operates in AUTO mode.

reversionary-right-knobs.title: First Officer Reversionary & Display Brightness Panel (PFD / MFD / ADS / IRS)
reversionary-right-knobs.description: Contains DISPLAY CONTROLLER (PFD / AUTO / MFD) reversion knob, DISPLAY BRIGHTNESS knobs (MFD 2 & PFD 2), and ADS / IRS sensor reversion pushbuttons.

flight-control-mode.title: FLIGHT CONTROL MODE Panel (ELEVATOR / AILERON / RUDDER)
flight-control-mode.description: Contains guarded mode switches for the Fly-By-Wire Elevator, Aileron, and Rudder actuators, allowing crew override or direct mode selection.

mcdu-left-keys.title: Left MCDU Keypad & Function Buttons (MCDU 1)
mcdu-left-keys.description: Alphanumeric keypad and mode keys (RTE, FPL, PERF, NAV, PROG, MENU, RADIO, DLK) for MCDU 1.

mcdu-right-keys.title: Right MCDU Keypad & Function Buttons (MCDU 2)
mcdu-right-keys.description: Alphanumeric keypad and mode keys (RTE, FPL, PERF, NAV, PROG, MENU, RADIO, DLK) for MCDU 2.

eng1-ign-knob.title: Engine 1 Ignition Selector Knob (OFF / AUTO / OVRD)
eng1-ign-knob.description: Controls Engine 1 igniters. AUTO: FADEC automatically controls ignition. OVRD: Continuous ignition on both igniters. OFF: Inhibits ignition for dry motoring.

eng2-ign-knob.title: Engine 2 Ignition Selector Knob (OFF / AUTO / OVRD)

eng1-start-knob.title: Engine 1 Start / Stop Selector Knob (STOP / RUN / START)
eng1-start-knob.description: Guarded rotary selector. RUN: Normal operating position. START: Momentary position initiating FADEC automatic start sequence. STOP: Shuts down Engine 1.

eng2-start-knob.title: Engine 2 Start / Stop Selector Knob (STOP / RUN / START)
eng2-start-knob.description: Guarded rotary selector for Engine 2 automatic starting (START), normal operation (RUN), and shutdown (STOP).

to-config-btn.title: T/O CONFIG (Takeoff Configuration Test) Pushbutton
to-config-btn.description: Pressing tests whether the aircraft is properly configured for takeoff (flaps, trims, speedbrake, parking brake). Announces 'TAKEOFF OK' or triggers a configuration warning.

ccd-pedestal-left.title: Left Cursor Control Device (CCD 1 Touchpad & Keys)
ccd-pedestal-left.description: Touchpad, Enter keys, and display selection buttons allowing the Captain to move the cursor across PFD 1, MFD 1, and MCDU 1.

ccd-pedestal-right.title: Right Cursor Control Device (CCD 2 Touchpad & Keys)
ccd-pedestal-right.description: Touchpad, Enter keys, and display selection buttons allowing the First Officer to move the cursor across MFD 2, PFD 2, and MCDU 2.

speedbrake-lever.title: SPEED BRAKE Lever (CLOSE / OPEN)
speedbrake-lever.description: Controls deployment of the wing multifunction spoilers as speedbrakes in flight.

thrust-levers.title: Engine 1 & 2 Thrust Levers (MAX / TOGA / MCT / IDLE / REV)
thrust-levers.description: Forward thrust and thrust-reverser levers with TO/GA (Takeoff/Go-Around) buttons and A/T quick-disconnect switches.

cockpit-door-panel.title: EICAS FULL Pushbutton
cockpit-door-panel.description: Toggles full-screen EICAS engine and system indications on the Multi-Function Display when pressed.

alt-gear-lever.title: RAT MANUAL DEPLOY (Ram Air Turbine) Lever
alt-gear-lever.description: Pulling the RAT MANUAL DEPLOY lever manually deploys the Ram Air Turbine (RAT) to provide emergency electrical power.

parking-brake.title: PARKING / EMERGENCY BRAKE Handle
parking-brake.description: Pulling and rotating applies hydraulic parking brake pressure; also provides proportional mechanical/hydraulic emergency brake application.

pitch-trim-sw.title: Left Audio Control Panel (ACP 1)
pitch-trim-sw.description: Captain Audio Control Panel: selects transmission buttons (VHF 1/2/3, HF, SAT, PA, INT) and reception volume knobs, oxygen mask/boom mic switch, and emergency audio backup.

yaw-trim-sw.title: Right Audio Control Panel (ACP 2)
yaw-trim-sw.description: First Officer Audio Control Panel: selects transmission buttons (VHF 1/2/3, HF, SAT, PA, INT), reception volume knobs, mask/boom switch, and emergency audio backup.

acp-left-knobs.title: TRIM Panel (ROLL, YAW & PITCH Backup Trim & SYS 1/2 Cutout)
acp-left-knobs.description: Contains ROLL trim switch (LWD/RWD), YAW trim switch, PITCH BACKUP switch (UP/DN), and guarded PITCH TRIM SYS 1 / SYS 2 cutout pushbuttons.

wx-tcas-knobs.title: COCKPIT DOOR Control Panel (OPEN / INHIB / TEST)
wx-tcas-knobs.description: Controls electronic locking/unlocking and access inhibition of the reinforced cockpit door. Includes OPEN, INHIB, and TEST pushbuttons/indicators.

cockpit-printer.title: Cockpit Thermal Printer
cockpit-printer.description: Prints ACARS datalink messages, weather reports (METAR/TAF), ATIS, clearances, flight plans, and maintenance reports. Includes PAPER, SLEW, and TEST/ERROR controls.

flap-lever.title: Flap Selector Lever (0 / 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / FULL)
flap-lever.description: Selects wing trailing-edge flap and leading-edge slat positions for takeoff, approach, and landing.

pa-btn-left.title: Captain PA (Passenger Address) Handset / Button
pa-btn-left.description: Captain Passenger Address handset socket and push-to-talk button located below the Parking / Emergency Brake handle for making cabin announcements.

pa-btn-right.title: First Officer PA (Passenger Address) Handset / Button
pa-btn-right.description: First Officer Passenger Address handset socket and push-to-talk button located below the Flap Selector Lever.

elevator-disc-handle.title: ELEVATOR DISC (Elevator Disconnect) Handle
elevator-disc-handle.description: Pulling the T-handle mechanically disconnects the left and right elevator control systems in the event of a jammed elevator.

rat-manual-deploy.title: AILERON DISC (Aileron Disconnect) Handle
rat-manual-deploy.description: Pulling the T-handle mechanically disconnects the left and right aileron control systems in the event of a jammed aileron.

lgwrn-gnd-prox-inhibits.title: LG WRN / GROUND PROX INHIBITS Panel (LG WRN / TERR / FLAP OVRD)
lgwrn-gnd-prox-inhibits.description: Contains guarded pushbuttons for Landing Gear Warning Inhibit (LG WRN INHB), Terrain Inhibit (TERR INHB), and Flap Override (FLAP OVRD).

cabin-non-essential.title: CABIN NON ESSENTIAL Power Switch
cabin-non-essential.description: Guarded pushbutton that sheds non-essential cabin electrical power (galley, in-flight entertainment, cabin outlets) in case of cabin smoke or electrical overload.

lower-pedestal-panel.title: Cockpit Voice Recorder / Maintenance Test Panel
lower-pedestal-panel.description: Lower pedestal panel located directly below the CABIN NON ESSENTIAL switch.

fgp-vnav-btn.title: Vertical Navigation (VNAV) Button
fgp-vnav-btn.description: Engages or arms FMS Vertical Navigation (VNAV) profile guidance, following pre-programmed vertical waypoints, altitude constraints, and speeds.

fgp-flch-btn.title: Flight Level Change (FLCH) Button
fgp-flch-btn.description: Engages Flight Level Change (FLCH) mode. The AFCS commands pitch to maintain the selected airspeed while throttles deliver climb or idle descent thrust.

ptt-capt-btn.title: Captain PTT / Boom Mic Jack
ptt-capt-btn.description: Auxiliary jack and push-to-talk (PTT) interface on the captain's glareshield panel for connecting the boom microphone or headset.

chart-light-capt-knob.title: Captain CHART Light Knob (OFF / BRT)
chart-light-capt-knob.description: Controls illumination of the captain's chart holder / clip light. Rotating clockwise from OFF smoothly increases brightness to maximum (BRT).

flood-storm-capt-knob.title: Captain FLOOD / STORM Light Knob (OFF / BRT)
flood-storm-capt-knob.description: Controls the captain's side glareshield floodlight and storm lighting. Rotating clockwise from OFF increases illumination to maximum brightness (BRT).

pfd-light-capt-knob.title: Captain PFD Brightness Control Knob (DIM / BRT)
pfd-light-capt-knob.description: Adjusts the display backlighting brightness of the Captain's Primary Flight Display (PFD 1) from DIM to BRT.

mfd-light-capt-knob.title: Captain MFD Brightness Control Knob (DIM / BRT)
mfd-light-capt-knob.description: Adjusts the display backlighting brightness of the Captain's Multi-Function Display (MFD 1) from DIM to BRT.

compass-light-fo-knob.title: COMPASS / Glareshield Light Knob (DIM / BRT)
compass-light-fo-knob.description: Controls the magnetic compass light and supplemental glareshield integral illumination from DIM to maximum brightness (BRT).

glareshield-light-fo-knob.title: COMPASS / Glareshield Light Knob (DIM / BRT)
glareshield-light-fo-knob.description: Controls the magnetic compass light and supplemental glareshield integral illumination from DIM to maximum brightness (BRT).

mfd-light-fo-knob.title: First Officer MFD Brightness Control Knob (DIM / BRT)
mfd-light-fo-knob.description: Adjusts the display backlighting brightness of the First Officer's Multi-Function Display (MFD 2 / EICAS) from DIM to BRT.

pfd-light-fo-knob.title: First Officer PFD Brightness Control Knob (DIM / BRT)
pfd-light-fo-knob.description: Adjusts the display backlighting brightness of the First Officer's Primary Flight Display (PFD 2) from DIM to BRT.

flood-storm-fo-knob.title: First Officer FLOOD / STORM Light Knob (OFF / BRT)
flood-storm-fo-knob.description: Controls the First Officer's side glareshield floodlight and storm lighting. Rotating clockwise from OFF increases illumination to maximum brightness (BRT).

chart-light-fo-knob.title: First Officer CHART Light Knob (OFF / BRT)
chart-light-fo-knob.description: Controls illumination of the First Officer's chart holder / clip light. Rotating clockwise from OFF smoothly increases brightness to maximum (BRT).

ptt-fo-btn.title: First Officer PTT / Boom Mic Jack
ptt-fo-btn.description: Auxiliary jack and push-to-talk (PTT) interface on the First Officer's glareshield panel for connecting the boom microphone or headset.
